import importlib
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from score_objective_floor_trial import load_module

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V150-objective-floor-v1')
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')
guard(plan);guard(post)
load_module(root/'review-source-v1.py','preflight_review')
for name in ['score_objective_floor_trial','audit_objective_floor_trial','render_objective_floor_trial']:
    importlib.import_module(name)
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
assert len(cases)==822
selected=[c for c in cases if c['kind']=='mixed-quiet']
selected += [c for c in cases if c['kind']=='mesh' and c['seed']==2026112302]
selected += [c for c in cases if c.get('cohort') in ['adc-photo256','adc-sloped512']]
assert len(selected)==64
metric=load_module(root.parent/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py','preflight_metrics')
photo=load_module(root.parent/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py','preflight_photo')
independent=load_module(root.parent/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py','preflight_independent')
maximum=0.;checks=0
for case in selected:
    assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays']
    assert ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
    a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));pred=np.load(case['parent']['path'])
    if case['kind']=='photo':
        first=photo.photo_metrics(pred,a['target'],a,case['ROI_xywh'])
        other=independent.photo_metrics(pred,a['target'],a,case['ROI_xywh'])
    else:
        first=metric.errors(pred,a['target'],case['ROI_xywh'])
        other=independent.errors(pred,a['target'],case['ROI_xywh'])
    for key,value in first.items():
        diff=abs(value-other[key]);maximum=max(maximum,diff);assert diff<1e-9*max(1,abs(value));checks+=1
    if case['kind']=='mesh':
        blank=np.all(a['target_present']==a['target_empty'],axis=1)[0] if case['present'] else np.ones((512,512),bool)
        error=(pred[0].astype(float)-a['target'][0].astype(float))[:,blank]
        dc=error.mean(1,keepdims=True)
        first=np.sqrt(np.mean((error-dc)**2))*65535
        other=np.sqrt(max(0,np.mean(error**2)-np.mean(dc**2)))*65535
        maximum=max(maximum,abs(first-other));assert abs(first-other)<1e-9;checks+=1
    if case['kind']=='mixed-quiet':
        x,y,w,h=case['ROI_xywh'];error=(pred.astype(float)-a['target'].astype(float))[...,y:y+h,x:x+w]
        first=np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2))*65535;other=np.linalg.norm(error)/np.sqrt(error.size)*65535
        maximum=max(maximum,abs(first-other));assert abs(first-other)<1e-9;checks+=1
    if case['kind']=='flat':
        error=pred.astype(float)-a['target'].astype(float);dc=error.mean((-2,-1),keepdims=True)
        blocks=error.reshape(1,3,16,32,16,32).mean((3,5))
        first=np.sqrt(np.mean((blocks-dc)**2))*65535
        listed=np.stack([error[...,j:j+32,i:i+32].mean((-2,-1)) for j in range(0,512,32) for i in range(0,512,32)],-1)
        other=np.sqrt(np.mean((listed-dc[...,0])**2))*65535
        maximum=max(maximum,abs(first-other));assert abs(first-other)<1e-9;checks+=1
old=[x for x in read(Path(plan['previous'])/'figures-v1.json')['images'] if 'triplet_source_board' not in x]
extra=[c for c in cases if c.get('cohort') in ['adc-photo256','adc-sloped512'] and c['pattern']=='RGGB']
assert len(old)==42 and len(extra)==6
triplet_bases=sum((x['case']['kind']=='mesh' and x['case']['present'] and x['contrast']==1) or (x['case']['kind']=='photo' and '3e638bbb' in x['case']['id']) for x in old)+sum(x['kind']=='photo' for x in extra)
assert triplet_bases==6 and 48+triplet_bases*4==72
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root/'postprocess-preflight-v1.json',{'status':'pass-frozen-imports-64-parent-metric-cases-and72-template-plan','postprocess_plan':ref(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'cached_parent_cases_checked':len(selected),'scalar_checks':checks,'maximum_formula_difference':maximum,'old_templates':42,'prospective_ADC_templates':6,'triplet_bases':6,'planned_primary_native_figures':72,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'CUDA_initialized':False,'scope':'32 mixed+8 all-CFA mesh+24 ADC parent cases. Independent base/photo/blank/quiet/block formulas and frozen imports. No endpoint inference or quality selection; cached parent values only.'})
print('PASS',len(selected),'parents,',checks,'scalars, max',maximum,'planned72 native figures')
